new_blockers.what: NOTE severity, and directly relevant to the A1 ratification the orchestrator must rule on. A stated term SHORTER than one period of its own schedule is accepted silently and can never post. Measured on clara_652 (branch-tip 0207): term 2026-07-01..2026-07-15, window 2026-07-01..2026-07-15, monthly/last_day_of_month -> ACCEPTED; clara.request_plan_catch_up over the whole window returns {"events":[],"admitted":0} and clara.accounting_plan_occurrences holds ZERO rows for the plan, at configure time and after catch-up. Same for a one-day term (2026-07-10..2026-07-10). The accrual row and a live plan exist, the list surface shows 'No due dates reached yet', and no due date will ever be reached. THE ZERO-OCCURRENCE ACCEPTANCE ITSELF IS PRE-EXISTING plan-lane behaviour, not introduced here: 0207 pins the six 0193 bodies byte-identically (its own tail proves it), and at review head b579e25a the same explicit effective_to='2026-07-15' was accepted the same way. What A1's wall changes is REACHABILITY -- effective_to is now NOT NULL and must satisfy effective_from >= service_period_start and effective_to <= service_period_end, so the 'leave it open-ended and it fires on the 31st' escape that previously rescued a short term is gone, making the silent shape the default one a preparer lands on. A workable configuration does exist and I measured it: the same half-month term with dayRule='day_of_month', dayOfMonth=15 materialises 2026-07-15/primary immediately. So this is not a blocked use case, it is an unannounced no-op. It is also the same class of defect the fix worker just closed for `method` under A2 ('a recorded selection nobody performs is a promise the ledger does not keep') -- an accrual that can never accrue.
new_blockers.fix: Not for this loop unless the orchestrator wants it with A1. Either (a) refuse at the door: after clara._assert_accrual_term_window, ask the plan lane whether the schedule yields at least one primary due date inside [effective_from, effective_to] and raise CLR10 with reason 'accrual_schedule_yields_no_occurrence' naming day_rule/day_of_month as the field, mirrored in apps/web/lib/work/accrual-draft.ts's localAccrualRefusal so the form catches it before the door; or (b) record it as a named residual in 652-final.md's follow-ups and in 0207's SIXTH MEASUREMENT header, since the underlying acceptance belongs to the #640/#653 plan lane this ticket pins and may not recut.
